_about: What of the launch-pair coverage table (launch-pair-coverage.json) plays in a live match now that the live loader and the energy events exist (docs/animation/pair-live.md). Rules are tried in order on every row that says live or parked; the first whose area (exact, or *), fighter (exact, or *) and `contains` (a substring of the row's item, optional) match sets its status. live: loaded by the live loader alone and started by an event or beat the sim sends today. wired: loaded, and the runtime starts it when the sim sends its trigger, which it does not yet (an entry beat that names an entry, a close-taunt cue, the shot kinds rain, split and curve, volley_fire, energy_shove, drop_the_act, regalia_release). baked: loaded for the fighter and nothing starts it yet (the emitting hands, the On the Chin, Blow for Blow and finisher poses, the checks). A row no rule matches keeps its status. Checked by render/anim/tools/coverage_live.gd.
